caption: Figure 14.5  Diagramatic presentation of ATP synthesis in mitochondria
note: Caption printed as "Diagramatic" in the book; copied as printed. The caption is set on two printed lines and is joined here with a single space. "Outer side" and "Inner mitochondrial membrane" are each printed on more than one line and joined with single spaces. Subscripts are written flat: F0 and F1 are printed with subscript 0 and 1, and Pi with a subscript i. The right-hand column of body prose and the section heading "14.5 The Respiratory Balance ..." are neighbouring blocks cut by the crop edge and are excluded, as is the page number "234".
